summary: The checkout-isolation command now correctly preserves the shared checkout, but the newly promoted PIT procedure can silently omit required mutation targets and leaves the focused path unable to preserve all required evidence.

findings.title: Default core PIT runner skips current root classes
findings.trigger: A delivery changes ScopeTermination, TaskTermination, CancellationReason, or another omitted root-package class and follows the new default by running scripts/run-pit-core.sh with --batch all.
findings.consequence: All A-E batches can complete and be recorded as core PIT evidence even though no mutant from the changed termination or cancellation class ran, allowing the required mutation check to miss a regression.
findings.evidence: commands.md:51-54 promotes the fixed runner as the default core partition. scripts/run-pit-core.sh:91-109 lists every target pattern and contains no ScopeTermination*, TaskTermination*, or CancellationReason* pattern; its comment at :91-93 says non-wildcard entries are exact. These are executable current root classes, for example core/src/main/java/io/github/monadrome/parallelinscope/ScopeTermination.java:18-165 and TaskTermination.java:21-91. verification/pit.md:19-25 and :37-42 require affected executable classes and broader core runs to cover root-package production classes.
findings.suggestedFix: Refresh the runner with a current complete root-class partition and add a check that every applicable root source matches exactly one batch. Until then, stop describing it as the default core scope and require explicit target classes for omitted sources.

findings.title: Focused PIT instructions require a log that the documented command never creates
findings.trigger: A developer runs the focused Maven command at verification/pit.md:91-94 and then follows the new requirement to copy its XML and log into durable evidence.
findings.consequence: There is no persisted Maven/PIT log to copy, so the run cannot satisfy the stated evidence requirement and later timeout or failure diagnosis lacks the required console output.
findings.evidence: verification/pit.md:91-95 invokes Maven without redirecting or teeing stdout/stderr, while the new text at :116-118 requires copying a log. core/pom.xml:391-394 configures PIT only for HTML and XML output. The dedicated runner creates pit.log only by explicit shell redirection at scripts/run-pit-core.sh:198.
findings.suggestedFix: Amend the focused-run procedure to create a durable evidence directory, capture Maven stdout and stderr into a named pit.log while preserving Maven's exit status, and then copy mutations.xml into that same directory. Alternatively, direct users to a runner that supports the focused scope.
